title: Poupou ki he My Quiet Bible
description: ʻOku taʻetotongi ʻa My Quiet Bible ki he tokotaha kotoa pē, ʻo taʻengata. Kapau ʻoku tokoni ia kiate koe, ʻe lava ke ke tokoni ke kei ulo ʻa e maama.
sub: Taʻetotongi ki he tokotaha kotoa pē, ʻo taʻengata. Kapau ʻoku tokoni ia kiate koe, ʻe lava ke ke tokoni ke kei ulo ʻa e maama.
kofiSub: Tuʻo taha, pe māhina kotoa pē. ʻAki ha kaati, Apple Pay pe Google Pay, ʻikai fiemaʻu ha lesisita.
leave: ʻOku ava ʻi ha peesi foʻou. Foki mai ki heni, pe ki he Tohitapu, ʻo ka ʻosi.
btcSub: On-chain pe Lightning, hangatonu ki homau sāvea pē ʻoʻomautolu, taʻe ha tokotaha ʻi he vahaʻa pe ha paati hono tolu.
btcAddressQr: Kouti QR ʻo e tuʻasila Bitcoin
where:
• Ko e ngaahi sāvea ʻoku ne fakalele ʻa e fakatatau mo e ngaahi kulupu.
  • Ko e ngaahi hingoa tomeini, ke kei ngāue ʻa e myquietbible.com.
  • Ko e ʻīmeili ʻoku ne ʻave ʻa e ngaahi kouti hū.
never: ʻE ʻikai loka ha meʻa ʻi he Tohitapu. Ko e foaki ko ha fakamālō, ʻo ʻikai ko ha tikite hū, pea ʻoku ʻikai ha meʻa ʻe liliu ʻi he ʻapi pe ʻokú ke foaki pe ʻikai.
tax: ʻOku ʻikai ko ha kautaha ʻofa kuo lesisita ʻa My Quiet Bible, ko ia ʻoku ʻikai fakasiʻisiʻi ai ha tukuhau koeʻuhí ko e ngaahi foaki.
otherH: Ngaahi founga kehe ke tokoni ai
other:
• Lotu ki he ngāue ko ʻení, pea ki he kakai ʻoku nau lau ʻaki ia.
  • ʻAve ʻa e myquietbible.com ki ha taha ʻoku ne saiʻia ʻi ha Tohitapu nonga.
about: Ko e hā ʻa e My Quiet Bible?
